description: This file defines an interface class 'IFactories' within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace, providing factory methods for creating web request and response objects, as well as JSONRPC related objects. The class includes static methods for singleton management and availability checks, along with pure virtual methods for object creation. It also includes some deprecated typedefs for backward compatibility.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class providing factory methods for web request/response objects and JSONRPC messages, with static methods for singleton pattern and availability status.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Sets the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the factory is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Web::Request proxy object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Web::Response proxy object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Web::FileBody proxy object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a JSONRPC message object.
